title: Right-endpoint sum
text: Divide [a,b] into $$n$$ equal pieces of width $$dx=\frac{b-a}{n}$$. $$R_n$$ adds f at the right end of each piece, then multiplies by dx.

title: Evaluate
text: $$dx=0.25$$ and the right endpoints are $$0.25$$, $$0.5$$, $$0.75$$, $$1$$. The values of g are $$\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$$, $$0$$, $$\frac{-\sqrt{2}}{2}$$, $$-1$$, which add to $$-1$$. Multiply by $$0.25$$ to get $$-0.25$$.
